title.en: Water - The Elixir of Life (Sir C. V. Raman)

text.en: People once searched for a magic drink that gave endless life, but the real elixir was always near.

Sir C. V. Raman says that people have long dreamed of an elixir of life, the divine Amrita, which would give immortality. He argues that the true elixir is plain water. He describes the line where the Libyan Desert meets the fertile Nile valley: on one side lifeless sand, on the other green fields and crowded towns, and the difference is water.
The essay also stresses conserving water. Soil erosion lets rain water run away quickly, so measures such as contour cultivation and planting suitable vegetation keep water on and in the soil. Such measures help both soil and water, so they serve a double purpose.
Words to learn: elixir, immortality, erosion, vegetation, contour cultivation and conserve. The essay uses examples and a personal memory to make a scientific point.
